Differences: Laps also calls Tell on areas and skips Enter for a `here` area, and falls back `or from` when Position is nil; Build runs Describe/Opens before ordering. items.why: The two blocks are token-identical for 13 lines: shallow-copy standsIn, reset objectives and quests, keep objectives whose quest is not in standsIn.planned, rebuild quests de-duplicated, Tell(lead). Only the lines after differ (planned replaces the step wherever it is in route and then Fronts it; nearest writes route[1]). Both implement the same rule stated in both comments ('keeps only the work they can do now, not objectives for quests the route has yet to pick up elsewhere') and the same rule as Workable (2023-2033), so a change to what counts as workable must land in both. No difference is intentional. A third partial copy of the objective filter is Refresh's Prune (4019-4024).
